title: NVIDIA acquires Hugging Face for $12.93 billion to control AI model distribution
summary: The purchase makes NVIDIA the owner of the largest open platform for AI models, maintaining its neutrality toward AMD and other hardware.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, its most advanced model ushering in the AGI era according to the company
summary: The new model stands out for its recurrent architecture and reasoning capabilities, but raises oversight and safety challenges.

title: NVIDIA unveils RTX Spark, its superchip for AI PCs with up to 6,144 CUDA cores and 128 GB of unified memory
summary: The chip integrates CPU and GPU in a single package and will arrive in laptops and desktops in October, boosting local AI on devices from Lenovo, ASUS, and others.

title: Google rolls out AI voice features in Gmail, Docs, and Keep and launches Gemini 3.8 Flash focused on cybersecurity
summary: The updates include video summaries in Gemini Notebook and a model that detects 70% of vulnerabilities, responding to Anthropic.

title: Meta launches Muse Spark 1.3 for agentic and coding tasks, and pays users to analyze its AI usage
summary: The update improves programming performance and reduces costs, while the company monitors how its model is employed.

title: Microsoft limits Xbox Cloud Gaming to 15 monthly hours for Game Pass Ultimate subscribers
summary: The measure takes effect in November and affects only cloud streaming, not local console or PC gaming.

title: AMD RDNA 5 to reach 3.1 to 3.4 GHz frequencies in upcoming RX 11000 graphics cards
summary: Internal leaks place maximum clocks above the current generation, anticipating a significant performance leap.

title: DLSS 5 becomes power stress test: an RTX 5090 consumes 802 W and delivers 20% more performance
summary: DLSS 5's exclusivity to RTX 50 series and its high power demand could give NVIDIA an advantage over AMD's FSR 5.

title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok suffer simultaneous outages without official explanation from OpenAI or Anthropic
summary: The leading chatbots stopped responding for hours, and Anthropic took longer to restore service, sparking speculation about the cause.

title: Nexus Mods buys SteamDB, the Steam database, promising to keep it ad-free and without paywalls
summary: The acquisition unites the largest mod community with the Steam price and data tracking tool, ensuring its continuity.

title: New robot vacuums arrive: Dreame with steam mopping, Dyson enters market, and Ecovacs launches flagship
summary: Competition intensifies with models that mop with steam at 180 degrees, submersible cameras, and 53 AW suction, while Lefant offers a budget option.

title: Windows 11 to enable VBS and Memory Integrity by default on more PCs, reducing FPS and limiting undervolting
summary: Microsoft tightens security by enabling hardware-based virtualization, which affects graphics performance and voltage adjustments.

title: Intel Nova Lake (LGA1954) to begin mass production in late 2026 and launch in 2027 with multi-generational support
summary: The new socket will allow multiple CPU generations and marks the end of the 'Fellow' title for engineers, demanding measurable business results.

title: Lenovo launches IdeaPad Vibe: 14- and 15-inch laptops with metal chassis, seven colors, and swappable keys starting at $699
summary: The new lineup bets on personalization and offers options with Snapdragon X and AMD Ryzen AI 400, unveiled at IFA alongside concepts like the fanless AeroBlade.
